input.quote: (g) not use the Work to act as a service bureau in whole or in part, for any other Person, except for any affiliate of Sparkling operating at the Authorized Locations.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no non-compete or field-of-use covenant binding Sparkling. Section 3 (Restrictions on Use) is limited to ordinary licence-scope restrictions on the Software and Documentation (no copying beyond backup, no reverse engineering, no sublicence/assignment, no service bureau use of the Work); none of these limit the businesses Sparkling may operate or the routing products it may buy or build. Section 19 is a mutual non-solicitation of employees (one year, both parties), not a non-compete, and Section 20 (General Matters) contains only boilerplate. Text searches for "compet", "develop" and "exclusiv" surface no competing-products, territory or field-of-use restriction on our party. Consistent with the playbook preferred position, no redline is required.
